cases.answer: There were 4,145,143 trips in March 2025 (Mar 1–Mar 31), averaging 133,714 trips per day. The total recorded amount was $110,111,232.04.

Trip volume changed month over month from January to June 2025 as follows: Jan (3,475,080 trips) → Feb (+2.94%) → Mar (+15.87%, peak at 4,145,143) → Apr (-4.22%) → May (+15.65%, highest at 4,591,720) → Jun (-5.86% to 4,322,709).

The top pickup zones by trips in March 2025 were: 1) Midtown Center (Manhattan) with 182,169 trips, 2) Upper East Side South (Manhattan) with 170,960 trips, and 3) JFK Airport (Queens) with 161,905 trips. Manhattan dominated the top 10 list, accounting for 8 of the top 10 zones.

The busiest drop-off zones in April 2025 were all in Manhattan. The top 3 were Upper East Side North (171,435 trips), Upper East Side South (168,755 trips), and Midtown Center (149,471 trips). Times Sq/Theatre District ranked 4th with 124,791 trips.

Average trip distance by hour (Jan 1 – Jun 30, 2025): shortest at 18:00 (2.89 mi), longest at 05:00 (5.78 mi). Midday hours (11:00–14:00) average ~3.1–3.3 mi. Early morning (00:00–06:00) ranges from 3.45 to 5.78 mi, with a peak at 05:00. Evening hours (19:00–23:00) average 3.09–3.91 mi.

For Jan 1 – Jun 30, 2025 (published data only), weekday trips (Mon–Fri) totaled 17,073,979 over 129 days (132,356 per day). Weekend trips (Sat–Sun) totaled 7,008,475 over 52 days (134,778 per day), a +1.83% difference per day. Total weekday volume was about 70% of total trips in the period.

Average total amount per trip was $26.86 in January 2025 and $29.49 in June 2025, representing a +9.78% increase from January to June. The comparison covers all trips in the NYC TLC Yellow Taxi system for Jan 1–31, 2025 (3,475,080 trips) and Jun 1–30, 2025 (4,322,709 trips), with no additional filters applied.
In May 2025, credit card payments accounted for 61.90% of all trips (2,842,137 trips). The remaining breakdown was: Flex Fare at 26.05%, Cash at 9.11%, Dispute at 2.29%, and No charge at 0.65%.

For the period Jan 1 – Jun 30, 2025 (all filters), there were 23,419,362 valid trips. The median trip distance is 1–2 miles. Very long trips (≥ 50 miles) account for only 2,921 trips (about 0.01% of all trips).

During processing of NYC TLC Yellow Taxi trip records from 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30, 930 rows were quarantined. The primary reasons were: 'Drop-off before pickup' (793 rows) and 'Outside the file's month' (137 rows).

No unusual days were found for average fares in the first half of 2025 (Jan 1 – Jun 30). Across all three analysis methods—daily vs same-weekday median, weekday grouping, and date grouping—zero days had a robust z-score ≥ 3.5, indicating no daily values deviated significantly from their usual levels for that weekday.
In March 2025, trips starting at JFK Airport (zone ID 132) totaled 161,905 trips, averaging 5,223 per day. The total recorded amount was $12,396,691.81 with an average of $81.76 per trip.

The period Jan 1 – Jun 30, 2025 was busy overall: 24,082,454 total trips (133,052 per day). Monthly volume ranged from 3.47M in January to a peak of 4.59M in May, with May being the busiest month and June the second lowest after April.
